title: ws/mod.rs: .to_string() on string literals — use .to_owned()
description: ws/mod.rs lines 103, 106, 186 call .to_string() on string literals and &str values: 'JmapRequest did not serialize...'.to_string(), request_id.to_string(), 'invalid auth header value'.to_string(). On string literals, .to_owned() or String::from() is idiomatic; on &str, .to_owned() avoids going through the Display trait. The distinction matters for readability and is flagged by clippy::str_to_string.
